summary:
Implementation plan for simplifying and decluttering the Enquiry Form and Package/Kit (Included Items) editor:
1. Unified Line Item Pricing Row + Simple Included Items Checklist: Keep one clean main row (Item Name, Qty, Unit, Selling Price, Total) for all items, and replace the complex Composite BOM editor with a straightforward Included Items / Sub-Items checklist (Qty, Unit, Item Name, optional Price, and collapsible note).
2. Remove Supplier Cost Markup Calculator & Hide Cost Behind Toggle: Remove the confusing Supplier Cost Markup % bar and keep Supplier Cost / Margin tucked inside the optional Cost & Margin toggle.
3. Fix Package Price Sync Bug: Ensure AI extraction and package conversion keep the package selling price on the main line item instead of zeroing it out or burying it in a Manual Lump-Sum Override.
4. Merge Duplicate Top Bars & Fix Step Numbering: Consolidate the sticky section jump bar and duplicate metadata pill bar into a single clean header/navigation bar with sequential 1-2-3 chapters (1. Client & Metadata, 2. Line Items, 3. Summary, Terms & Files).
